candidate_decisions.rollback_path: Delete the isolated property probe and its workflow reference; no canonical or market rollback is required.

candidate_decisions.incremental_value_assessment: The rows report no external backend or persisted raw output, but do not supply measurements across multiple research jobs showing improved complexity-tax decisions.
candidate_decisions.master_monday_note: Privacy properties reported as passing; cost, failure, and cross-job usefulness evidence remains absent.
candidate_decisions.rationale: The promotion gate requires useful measurements across multiple research jobs. The supplied evidence does not report the needed job-level measurements, schema stability, or incremental decision value.

candidate_decisions.incremental_value_assessment: The initial harness caught bytecode working-tree contamination, demonstrating practical value. The supplied prospective rows do not establish a false-block rate across legitimate shadow-candidate changes.
candidate_decisions.master_monday_note: Contamination detection is promising; retain shadow status while observing real candidate-infrastructure changes and false blocks.
candidate_decisions.rationale: Self-test and postflight passes on an unchanged observed target do not establish repeated zero-false-positive operation on legitimate shadow work. The preregistered promotion gate remains unproven.

decision.master_monday_summary: All four candidates remain in shadow testing. Low-cost, promising results do not yet establish the respective promotion gates or measurable incremental value after complexity tax. The two prospective rows share one target code hash, so they demonstrate repeatability, not evidence across distinct real changes. No operational, blocking, canonical, market, or portfolio authority changes are authorized.
